description: Admin panel layout, routing, store, and all CRUD pages (Family/Category, Design Family/Subfamily, SKU Master, SKU Compatibility, Catalogue Management, Rule Set Management). This is a single large feature because all pages share the same layout pattern and data types.
steps: 1. Create src/stores/adminStore.ts - a Zustand store that manages admin panel state: current active page/section, loading states, error messages, and CRUD data for families, categories, design families, design subfamilies, SKUs, compatibility rules, catalogue entries, and rule sets. Include async actions that use fromTable() to fetch/create/update/delete records. Include storage upload action using supabase.storage.from('catalogue-assets').upload().

2. Create src/components/Admin/AdminLayout.tsx - a layout component with a left sidebar nav (links: Families & Categories, Design Families, SKU Master, Compatibility, Catalogue, Rule Sets) and a right content area using Outlet. Style with inline styles matching existing patterns. Include a header showing 'Admin Panel' and user info.

3. Create src/components/Admin/AdminRoute.tsx - a route guard component that checks useAuthStore role === 'ADMIN'. If not ADMIN, redirects to /. If loading, shows loading spinner. Otherwise renders Outlet.

4. Create src/pages/admin/FamilyCategoryPage.tsx - CRUD page for family_master and category_master. Show a table of families with inline add/edit/delete. When a family is selected, show its categories below with add/edit/delete. Use data-testid attributes.
5. Create src/pages/admin/DesignFamilyPage.tsx - CRUD page for design_family_master and design_subfamily_master. Same pattern as FamilyCategoryPage: table of design families, nested subfamilies.

6. Create src/pages/admin/SkuMasterPage.tsx - Full CRUD for sku_master. List view with filters (product_type, family, category, status). Create/Edit form with product-type-dependent field validation: WALL_PANEL requires width_mm, height_mm, thickness_mm; LIGHT requires width_mm, height_mm; FURNITURE requires width_mm, height_mm, depth_mm. Validate gh_mm 0-10, gv_mm 0-10, width_mm > 0 when present. Status badges for ACTIVE/INACTIVE. Include activate/deactivate actions.

7. Create src/pages/admin/SkuCompatibilityPage.tsx - Define relationships between SKUs. Show existing compatibility rules in a table. Add form with source SKU, target SKU (searchable dropdowns), relationship_type (REQUIRES/COMPATIBLE_WITH/ALTERNATIVE_TO), directionality (UNIDIRECTIONAL/BIDIRECTIONAL), is_mandatory toggle. Status ACTIVE/INACTIVE with toggle.

8. Create src/pages/admin/CataloguePage.tsx - View catalogue entries per SKU. Show status (INCOMPLETE/READY) with badges. For each entry show its assets (GEOMETRY/PATTERN/RENDER). Upload form: select asset type, choose file (SVG for GEOMETRY, PNG for PATTERN, PNG/JPEG for RENDER), upload to Supabase Storage bucket 'catalogue-assets' with path pattern '<sku_id>/<asset_type>/<timestamp>.<ext>'. Show signed URL previews for uploaded assets. Include 'Approve Ready' button that updates catalogue_entry status to READY.

9. Create src/pages/admin/RuleSetPage.tsx - View/edit rule_set records. Table showing rule_set_code, version, status (DRAFT/ACTIVE/SUPERSEDED), effective dates. Edit form for constants JSONB field (render as JSON textarea with validation). Status management: DRAFT -> ACTIVE -> SUPERSEDED transitions.
10. Create src/pages/admin/index.ts - barrel file re-exporting all admin pages.

11. Update src/main.tsx - Add admin routes under ProtectedRoute: nest AdminRoute > AdminLayout with child routes for each page. Import lazily or directly. Routes: /admin (redirects to /admin/families), /admin/families, /admin/design-families, /admin/skus, /admin/compatibility, /admin/catalogue, /admin/rule-sets.
12. Update src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx - Change ADMIN card onClick handlers to navigate to /admin/skus, /admin/catalogue, /admin/rule-sets respectively instead of /canvas.

13. Add database types for RuleSet and DesignFamily/DesignSubfamily to src/types/database.ts if not already present: DesignFamilyMaster (design_family_id, name, created_by, created_at), DesignSubfamilyMaster (design_subfamily_id, design_family_id, name, created_by, created_at), RuleSet (rule_set_id, rule_set_code, version, status, effective_from, effective_to, constants, created_by).

14. Create src/stores/__tests__/adminStore.test.ts - Tests for the admin store covering: initial state, CRUD action invocations, error handling, and state transitions. Mock fromTable() as done in skuStore.test.ts.

15. Create src/pages/admin/__tests__/AdminPages.test.tsx - Tests for admin pages: AdminRoute blocks non-ADMIN, AdminLayout renders sidebar, each page renders its main elements. Use MemoryRouter pattern from existing test files.
acceptance_criteria: Running 'npx vite build' completes without TypeScript errors
Running 'npx vitest run' passes all existing 320 tests plus new admin tests
Running 'npx tsc --noEmit' produces no type errors
Admin routes (/admin/*) are only accessible to ADMIN role users
Dashboard ADMIN cards navigate to the correct admin sub-pages
SKU form validates product-type-dependent required fields and gh/gv_mm range 0-10
Status badges display for ACTIVE/INACTIVE and READY/INCOMPLETE
All new components use data-testid attributes for testability
